protocol.admission: Exclude earlier report work hashes and normalized twelve-word matches, including the Qwen shard. Use exact three-sentence anchors within a source paragraph, with publisher spans matching both the complete edited sentence and the tagged text. Prefer paraphrase, compress, then polish and the earliest source position. Keep every work with a case from both registered generators.
protocol.construction: Join each selected report edit with a historical journal or technical documentation revision. Alternate paragraph order and include separate ordinary-only pairs with distinct sources.
protocol.comparison: Compare the existing complete-draft word diff against a local word diff constrained by unchanged neighboring sentences. Keep precisely the same pinned model responses and doubling-of-odds rule. Count exact later sentence matches, assessability, and false flags by original ordinary work.
protocol.decision: Require at least four additional exact locations across both generators and at least three report works on the new source panel, with no more than two additional ordinary works flagged. Preserve all assessed incumbent outcomes. The optional check contributes zero to authorship confidence.
